benchmark_rules: Primary reproduction path is analysis of pre-collected energy + uftrace data via methods in `energydebug.ipynb` (log alignment, hotspot localization, memcpy isolation).
Subjects in the artifact: Redis, PostgreSQL, and memcpy microbenchmarks across Alpine/musl vs Ubuntu/glibc style configurations.

Shared mount is read-only. Copy notebooks/scripts under `project/` before modification; write results under `project/` or `results/`.
New EnergiBridge collection needs bare-metal AMD/Intel MSR privileges and is usually unavailable in sandbox — disclose when reusing mounted traces instead of re-measuring.
Do not invent synthetic energy traces when the EnergyDebug artifact is mounted.
non_goals: Reporting only image size differences without energy/power metrics
Claiming a new root cause without aligning traces to energy timelines (or an equivalent localization step)
